name: Mere club
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, Adventurer's Armory pg. 4
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 17, Adventurer's Armory pg. 4
Statistics
Cost 2 gp Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x2; Range —; Type B or P; Special fragile
Category One-Handed; Proficiency Simple
Weapon Groups Close; Hammers
Description
A Stone Age weapon traditionally made of carved stone, a mere (MEH-reh) is a short, flat-sided, sharp-pointed club.
